rules.condition: val is empty string or all characters in SUPPORTED_WHITESPACE_CHARS
rules.rejection: ValueError('{field_name} cannot be null, empty, or whitespace-only.')

rules.condition: val consists entirely of characters in SUPPORTED_WHITESPACE_CHARS | {'\u180e'}
rules.rejection: ValueError('{field_name} blank-only string involving version-sensitive U+180E is explicitly unsupported.')

rules.rejection: ValueError('Unsupported non-ASCII boundary whitespace code point ... in identity field ...')

rules.condition: Repeated separators (//, \\, \/, /\), empty interior segments, UNC, ADS, traversal, reserved DOS names
Missing, None, boolean, or non-integer st_file_attributes, or reparse point (attrs & 0x400)
